name: Tsogo Sun Limited
source: Tsogo Sun Limited condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 March 2026, Rm scaled to ZAR, as published in the Notice of Annual General Meeting 2026: income 11,134 (2025: 11,155), gaming levies and VAT 2,012 (2,036), operating profit 2,455 (2,436), finance income 34 (52), finance costs 603 (761), share of profit of associates 6 (2), profit before income tax 1,892 (1,729), income tax 589 (535), profit for the year 1,303 (1,194), basic and diluted earnings per share 126 cents (120 cents). Revenue is the statement's income line. Cost of sales is gaming levies and VAT, the direct cost of revenue. Operating expenses 6,667 is employee costs 1,933 plus other operating expenses 3,723 plus amortisation and depreciation 676 plus net impairment of non-current assets 340 less fair value gain on investment properties 5, and gross profit less that figure reproduces the printed operating profit of 2,455 exactly. Net finance costs 569 is finance costs 603 less finance income 52; profit before tax is 2,455 less 569 plus share of associates 6 equals 1,892. The FY2026 column was published as reviewed and the FY2025 comparatives as audited.
